query: SELECT t.ordinality AS "ordinality!", prm.source_provider_model_id AS "provider_model_id!" FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[], $2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(provider_id, upstream_model, ordinality) JOIN providers p ON p.id = t.provider_id JOIN provider_revision_models prm ON prm.provider_revision_id = p.active_revision_id AND prm.upstream_model = t.upstream_model AND prm.enabled WHERE p.state <> 'disabled'::provider_state
